content.title: 图形复位｜身份卡与动作证明交替
content.summary: 从一次紧凑的身份激活开始，让稳定的图形身份复位与短促的实拍动作证明交替出现；后段提高动作难度，最后把峰值动作轮廓收回到一帧完整主体锁定图中。

quick_start.input_format: 同一原创角色或机器 + 固定图形身份卡 + 至少2段不同动作证明 + 图形复位分隔 + 后段能力升级 + 动作轮廓回收到最终全身锁定
quick_start.recommended_input: 一台原创折叠式轨道救援无人机先以白色陶瓷装甲、铜色关节和单一红色图标完成身份激活；石墨灰技术卡复位身份，再分别用抓取漂浮器材和抬起外部护板证明两项能力；最后把无人机与护板的斜向轮廓收回到最终全身技术卡中。
required_anchors: Begin with one compact identity activation before showing the complete subject.
Establish one clearly different graphic reset mode that preserves subject silhouette and proportions.
Raise physical demand in the later action proof while keeping the same defining silhouette and direction cues.
Carry the peak action contour into the final graphic state and hold a complete-subject lockup.
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 从一次紧凑的身份激活开始，让稳定的图形身份复位与短促的实拍动作证明交替出现；后段提高动作难度，最后把峰值动作轮廓收回到一帧完整主体锁定图中。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: 稳定身份字卡与短促动作段交替出现，每次回到图形复位都保持同一角色轮廓与配色；后段动作升级，终局回到原创名称与英雄姿态。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One original character silhouette persists."

invariants.rule: Graphic resets alternate with bounded action proofs.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Graphic resets alternate with bounded action proofs."

invariants.rule: Palette and line texture bind both media states.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Palette and line texture bind both media states."

invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Action difficulty rises once."

invariants.rule: The final lockup restores a complete readable identity.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final lockup restores a complete readable identity."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
